title: Buckwheat with Shrimps & Fresh Salad
description: Garlic shrimps served over buckwheat with a fresh salad of lettuce, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and Greek yogurt dressing.

mealPrep.reheatNotes: Keep salad separate. Reheat buckwheat and shrimps in a pan or microwave. Add salad fresh before eating.

steps: Cook in a pot with 1:2 water ratio over medium heat until all water is absorbed, about 15–20 minutes.
Season with salt, fluff with a fork, and set aside.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat with a little oil.
Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add shrimps, season with salt and black pepper.
Cook for 2–3 minutes per side until pink and cooked through.
Chop lettuce, halve cherry tomatoes, and slice cucumber.
Add cooked shrimps to the salad.
Mix everything together with Greek yogurt as dressing.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Top or serve alongside the shrimp salad.
